reports.biz: Relay Wire / Web Envy / Med Pulse Fake Invoice Phishing and Identity Theft Scam
reports.desc: I received an unsolicited fax from Med Pulse requesting payment for Secure Fax Routing & Encryption and other services I did not sign up for. After reviewing this "company" I noted that this is a probable scam as I did not sign up for any of the listed services nor had I heard about this company previous to receiving the fax.

Since October 2025, I have received over 610 unsolicited prerecorded calls promoting supposed personal loans/debt relief. I have NEVER applied for a loan, answered these calls, returned a call, or consented to these solicitations. The callers continually rotate/spoof caller-ID numbers while directing recipients to recurring callback numbers using fictitious stories. Recent messages claim I have an existing “file,” that supervisors/underwriters have reviewed it, and, often lately, that numerous employees have repeatedly tried to reach me. This caller offered an unsolicited $60,000 unsecured personal loan, saying i was one of a very few who had been approved. Other recordings use similar fictitious personal stories and loan approvals. I have preserved numerous voicemails, screenshots, dates, caller-ID numbers and callback numbers and have reported this to the FTC numerous times. This appears to be a large-scale, persistent robocall campaign

This person sold a vehicle and said that the engine/timing belt were replaced. Later it was discovered that the vehicle was sent to the scrapyard by the original owner and he then sold it without registering it under his name. No contact has been made to clarify this situation. The shop that was noted on the Carfax report as who changed the engine, said that they didn’t do the work and the original owner said that it was sold to Tiger Auto Recycling/Tiger Cash For Junk. Contact with Gerardo Salazar and the junkyard have been unsuccessful. The vehicle now needs the engine fixed. There are others who have been scammed on Facebook Marketplace by the same person.

I received 2 phones yesterday, 10/20/2026.  The first call came aat 1:07 pm informing me of Suspicious Bank Pending Transaction with Home Depot in Phoenix.  She claim to be calling from Chase Bank.  The 2nd call came at 2:09pm, same person.  She claimed the my Debit Card had in fact been compromised.  Did I want to get a replacement Debit Card sent regular mail or Expedited.  I said Expedited if there is no charge.  She agreed and proceeded to ask for my Password/ Bank Secret Code so she could process the Debit Card Replacement.  I said I NEVER GIVE out that information, especially over the phone.  I will go to the bank and request a Replacement Debit Card at the office!!  This ended any further discussion.  I contacted Chase to inform them of the Suspicious Bank Scam.

I hired Mariachi Flor de Primavera for an event and sent the deposit as requested. Communication was going well through email, text messages, and phone calls—until the day of the event. Suddenly, they stopped responding and never showed up. Later, they sent me a message claiming there had been a scheduling mix-up and promised to refund my deposit.
